title: Sampling, Communication, and Prediction Co-Design for Synchronizing the Real-World Device and Digital Model in Metaverse
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical aspects of synchronizing real-world devices and their digital models in the metaverse, specifically addressing sampling, communication, and prediction co-design using a constrained deep reinforcement learning algorithm. There is no component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core part of the study.
